title: Media Stack
description: Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Bazarr, Seerr and Themearr.

target.expr: {container="app-jellyfin"} |= "started playback of" | regexp `User (?P<user>.+?) started playback of '(?P<title>.*)' \(` | line_format "{{.user}}: {{.title}}"
{container="app-jellyfin"} |= "stopped playback of" | regexp `User (?P<user>.+?) stopped playback of '(?P<title>.*)' at` | line_format "{{.user}}: {{.title}}"

panels.title: Jellyfin
panels.description: From the Docker state and healthcheck of the container.

panels.title: Sonarr
panels.description: From the Docker state and healthcheck of the container.

panels.title: Themearr
panels.description: From the Docker state and healthcheck of the container.

panels.title: Streams now
panels.description: Sessions with an item in play, including paused ones.

panels.title: Low buffer
panels.description: Transcoded streams with less than 10 seconds ready ahead of the player. These streams are about to stall.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx
panels.description: Server errors in the last 15 minutes. Needs EnableMetrics in Jellyfin.

panels.title: Stream p95
panels.description: Response time of video and audio requests in the last 5 minutes. Needs EnableMetrics in Jellyfin.

panels.title: Slow HTTP
panels.description: Slow responses in the last hour. Jellyfin logs these if the slow response warning is on in its settings.

panels.title: FFmpeg fails
panels.description: Transcodes that ended with an error code in the last hour. A client that stops a stream can also cause a non-zero code.

panels.title: IO pressure
panels.description: The share of time that tasks on the host waited for disks.

panels.title: Now playing
panels.description: One row for each stream. Low buffer is the first sign of a stall. Reasons shows why Jellyfin transcodes. Buffer and speed are blank when a transcode has not started or is complete, and for streams with no transcode.

panels.title: Transcode buffer ahead
panels.description: Seconds ready ahead of the player. Below the line, the player is about to stall. This updates when the client reports its position, about each 10 seconds. A line stops when the transcode is complete, which is normal.

panels.title: Transcode speed
panels.description: 1 is real time. Below 1 with a low buffer means the host cannot keep up. Below 1 with a high buffer is usually normal throttling.

panels.title: Stream response time
panels.description: Needs EnableMetrics in Jellyfin.

panels.title: Jellyfin errors by source
panels.description: Metadata errors are usually not playback problems.

panels.title: Stream and host events
panels.description: Library scans read many files from Vault, so they can slow streams.

panels.title: DERP now
panels.description: What Jellyfin sends through DERP relays now. With a stream on, a value above 10 kB/s means that a client has no direct path. The Jellyfin stream uses DERP alert uses the same limit. These metrics do not show which client.

panels.title: What Jellyfin sends, by path
panels.description: Traffic from the Jellyfin node to tailnet clients. Compare it with the stream start and stop marks. LAN traffic that does not use the tailnet is not here.

panels.title: Groups
panels.description: Groups created in the selected time.

panels.title: Joins
panels.description: Times that a session joined a group.

panels.title: Leaves
panels.description: Times that a session left a group. More leaves than you expect can mean that clients drop out.

panels.title: Group waits
panels.description: Times that a playing group stopped to wait for a client.

panels.title: Buffer requests
panels.description: Times that a client told the group that it has to buffer.

panels.title: Seeks
panels.description: Seeks in the group. Seeks that nobody asked for can mean that clients correct their position.

panels.title: Client requests by type
panels.description: Buffer and Ready show waits: the group stops for all clients when one client buffers. The panel hides Ping, which is normal background traffic.

targets.expr: sum by (op) (count_over_time({container="app-jellyfin"} |= "SyncPlay.Group" |= " requested " !~ "requested Ping" | regexp "requested (?P<op>[A-Za-z]+) in group" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Group state changes
panels.description: Playing to Waiting is a stop for the whole group.

targets.expr: sum by (src, dst) (count_over_time({container="app-jellyfin"} |= "SyncPlay.Group" |= "switching from" | regexp "switching from (?P<src>[A-Za-z]+) to (?P<dst>[A-Za-z]+)" [$__auto]))

panels.title: SyncPlay events by person
panels.description: Each group event, with the Jellyfin user and device of the session. The user comes from jellyfin_stream_info, so a session that never played anything shows no user. Kept the group waiting, Out of sync, Paused to catch up and Buffering show who slows the group down.

targets.expr: sum by (session, event) (count_over_time({container="app-jellyfin"} |= "SyncPlay" !~ "requested Ping" | regexp "[Ss]ession(\\(s\\))? (?P<session>[0-9a-f]{8})" | regexp "(?P<event>requested [A-Za-z]+|joined group|left group|created group|is recovering|got lost in time|resumed playback|will pause when ready|to report ready, giving up)" | session != "" | event != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Buffer ahead for each client
panels.description: Only for transcodes. A client with a low buffer can stop the group.

targets.expr: jellyfin_stream_buffer_seconds * on (session) group_left (user, client, title) jellyfin_stream_info

panels.title: Position gap in one title
panels.description: The gap between the first and last client that play the same title. Clients report their position about each 10 seconds, so a small gap is normal. Two people who watch one title separately also show here.

targets.expr: (max by (title) (jellyfin_stream_position_seconds * on (session) group_left (title) jellyfin_stream_info) - min by (title) (jellyfin_stream_position_seconds * on (session) group_left (title) jellyfin_stream_info)) and on (title) (count by (title) (jellyfin_stream_info) > 1)

panels.title: SyncPlay request time, p95
panels.description: A slow server response makes clients drift apart.

panels.title: SyncPlay events
panels.description: All group events, without Ping.

panels.title: Pressure: time spent waiting
panels.description: The share of time that at least one task waited. A rise at the time of a problem points to host load.

panels.title: Disk busy (top 8)
panels.description: nvme0n1 is the Fast pool. The sd disks are Vault.

panels.title: Top CPU containers
panels.description: 1.0 is one full core. Shows what else used the host at that time.

panels.title: TCP retransmits and NIC errors
panels.description: A rise suggests a network problem, not a disk or CPU problem.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Clients that are connected, whether or not they play.

panels.title: Streams by method
panels.description: Transcode uses the most CPU or GPU.

panels.title: HTTP latency, p95
panels.description: Slow responses during playback usually mean that the disks or the CPU are busy.

panels.title: Missing episodes
panels.description: Monitored episodes that have no file.

panels.title: Cutoff not met
panels.description: Episodes that have a file below the wanted quality.

panels.title: Health issues
panels.description: The same issues as System -> Status in Sonarr.

panels.title: Missing movies
panels.description: Monitored movies that have no file.

panels.title: Cutoff not met
panels.description: Movies that have a file below the wanted quality.

panels.title: Health issues
panels.description: The same issues as System -> Status in Radarr.

panels.title: Active health issues
panels.description: Empty means that no application reports an issue.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: 1.0 is one full core.
